chemistry-e1-l1.title: Zvinhu nezvekuvaka: hunhu hwakasiyana · Kuongorora kwekutanga nenheyo huru
chemistry-e1-l1.concept: Zvinhu zvinoumba zvinhu zvinonzi zvekuvaka. Simbi, purasitiki, girazi nerabha zvega zvine hunhu hwakasiyana.
chemistry-e1-l1.example: Windo rinogadzirwa negirazi rinopfuura chiedza, uye tayi inogadzirwa nerabha inotambanuka uye inoramba kuparara.

chemistry-e1-l2.title: Zvinhu nezvekuvaka: hunhu hwakasiyana · Kuongorora data nekugadzirisa matambudziko
chemistry-e1-l2.concept: Kuvaka kugona kutsanangura data yekuyedza nekugadzirisa matambudziko ekushandisa muupenyu hwezuva nezuva pahunhu hwakasiyana hwezvinhu nezvekuvaka.
chemistry-e1-l2.example: Gadzira mhedziso dzesainzi dzekuongorora nekuongorora kukanganisa kuburikidza nekuongorora data yehuwandu.

chemistry-e2-l1.title: Zvinhu zvinonyungudika mumvura nemusanganiswa · Kuongorora kwekutanga nenheyo huru
chemistry-e2-l1.concept: Kana chinhu chasanganiswa zvakaenzana nemvura chikasaonekwa, chinonzi ‘kunyungudika (dissolve)’. Zvinhu zvisingananyungudiki zvinonyura pazasi kana kuyangarara.
chemistry-e2-l1.example: Munyu unonyungudika zvakajeka mumvura, asi jecha harinyungudiki rinonyura pazasi.

chemistry-e2-l2.title: Zvinhu zvinonyungudika mumvura nemusanganiswa · Kuongorora data nekugadzirisa matambudziko
chemistry-e2-l2.concept: Kuvaka kugona kutsanangura data yekuyedza nekugadzirisa matambudziko ekushandisa muupenyu hwezuva nezuva pazvinhu zvinonyungudika mumvura nemusanganiswa.
chemistry-e2-l2.example: Gadzira mhedziso dzesainzi dzekuongorora nekuongorora kukanganisa kuburikidza nekuongorora data yehuwandu.

chemistry-e3-l1.title: Mamiriro matatu ezvinhu: chakasimba, mvura, gasi · Kuongorora kwekutanga nenheyo huru
chemistry-e3-l1.concept: Chakasimba chine chimiro nehuwandu zvakagara. Mvura inochinja chimiro zvichienderana nechirongo asi huwandu hwayo hwakagara. Gasi rinochinja chimiro nehuwandu zvose zvakasununguka.
chemistry-e3-l1.example: Echine (chakasimba), mvura (mvura) nemhute (gasi) mamiriro matatu emvura.

chemistry-e3-l2.title: Mamiriro matatu ezvinhu: chakasimba, mvura, gasi · Kuongorora data nekugadzirisa matambudziko
chemistry-e3-l2.concept: Kuvaka kugona kutsanangura data yekuyedza nekugadzirisa matambudziko ekushandisa muupenyu hwezuva nezuva pamamiriro matatu ezvinhu: chakasimba, mvura, gasi.
chemistry-e3-l2.example: Gadzira mhedziso dzesainzi dzekuongorora nekuongorora kukanganisa kuburikidza nekuongorora data yehuwandu.

chemistry-e4-l1.title: Kuvhuvhuta, kuvira, condensation nekuchinja kwevolume yeechine · Kuongorora kwekutanga nenheyo huru
chemistry-e4-l1.concept: Mvura kushanduka kuita gasi ndiko kuita gasi (kuvhuvhuta, kuvira), gasi kushanduka kuita mvura ndiko kuita mvura (condensation), uye chakasimba kushanduka kuita mvura kunonzi kunyungudika.
chemistry-e4-l1.example: Muchando chakaoma, kana mvura yaita echine volume inowedzera uye makani echinwiwa nemabhodhoro epurasitiki anozvimba.

chemistry-e4-l2.title: Kuvhuvhuta, kuvira, condensation nekuchinja kwevolume yeechine · Kuongorora data nekugadzirisa matambudziko
chemistry-e4-l2.concept: Kuvaka kugona kutsanangura data yekuyedza nekugadzirisa matambudziko ekushandisa muupenyu hwezuva nezuva pakuvhuvhuta, kuvira, condensation nekuchinja kwevolume yeechine.
chemistry-e4-l2.example: Gadzira mhedziso dzesainzi dzekuongorora nekuongorora kukanganisa kuburikidza nekuongorora data yehuwandu.

chemistry-e5-l1.title: Solute, solvent, solution nekuvava (concentration) · Kuongorora kwekutanga nenheyo huru
chemistry-e5-l1.concept: Chinhu chinonyungudika ndiyo solute, mvura inonyungudisa ndiyo solvent, uye mvura yakasanganiswa zvakaenzana ndiyo solution. Kunyangwe wakatora pachikamu chipi chesolution, kuravira, ruvara nekuvava zvakaenzana.
chemistry-e5-l1.example: Kana munyu (solute) wanyungudika mumvura (solvent), munyu-mvura (solution) unoumbwa.

chemistry-e5-l2.title: Solute, solvent, solution nekuvava (concentration) · Kuongorora data nekugadzirisa matambudziko
chemistry-e5-l2.concept: Kuvaka kugona kutsanangura data yekuyedza nekugadzirisa matambudziko ekushandisa muupenyu hwezuva nezuva pasolute, solvent, solution nekuvava (concentration).
chemistry-e5-l2.example: Gadzira mhedziso dzesainzi dzekuongorora nekuongorora kukanganisa kuburikidza nekuongorora data yehuwandu.

chemistry-e6-l1.title: Acid, base nezvinhu zvitatu zvekuvaka moto · Kuongorora kwekutanga nenheyo huru
chemistry-e6-l1.concept: Solution ine acid (vhiniga, muto werimau) inoshandura pepa rebhuruu re litmus kuita tsvuku, uye solution ine base (mvura ine sipo) inoshandura pepa retsvuku kuita bhuruu. Kupisa kunoda chinhu chinopisa, oxygen, netembiricha iri pamusoro pepakuvaka.
chemistry-e6-l1.example: Kana vhiniga yakawedzerwa kuchiratidzo chekabichi tsvuku inoita tsvuku, uye kana mvura ine sipo yakawedzerwa inoshanduka kuita bhuruu/yero.

chemistry-e6-l2.title: Acid, base nezvinhu zvitatu zvekuvaka moto · Kuongorora data nekugadzirisa matambudziko
chemistry-e6-l2.concept: Kuvaka kugona kutsanangura data yekuyedza nekugadzirisa matambudziko ekushandisa muupenyu hwezuva nezuva paacid, base nezvinhu zvitatu zvekuvaka moto.
chemistry-e6-l2.example: Gadzira mhedziso dzesainzi dzekuongorora nekuongorora kukanganisa kuburikidza nekuongorora data yehuwandu.

chemistry-m1-l1.title: Mutemo waBoyle, Mutemo waCharles nekuchinja kwemamiriro · Kuongorora kwekutanga nenheyo huru
chemistry-m1-l1.concept: Patembiricha inogara yakafanana, volume yegasi inopesana nekudzvinyirirwa (Mutemo waBoyle: $PV=\text{inogara}$). Patembiricha yakafanana yekudzvinyirirwa, volume yegasi inowirirana netembiricha (Mutemo waCharles).
chemistry-m1-l1.example: Kana bhora retable tennis rakatsikwa rakaiswa mumvura inopisa, zvidimbu zvegasi zvinofamba zvakanyanya uye bhora rinotenderera.

chemistry-m1-l2.title: Mutemo waBoyle, Mutemo waCharles nekuchinja kwemamiriro · Kuongorora data nekugadzirisa matambudziko
chemistry-m1-l2.concept: Kuvaka kugona kutsanangura data yekuyedza nekugadzirisa matambudziko ekushandisa muupenyu hwezuva nezuva paMutemo waBoyle, Mutemo waCharles nekuchinja kwemamiriro.
chemistry-m1-l2.example: Gadzira mhedziso dzesainzi dzekuongorora nekuongorora kukanganisa kuburikidza nekuongorora data yehuwandu.

chemistry-m2-l1.title: Element, atomu, ion nechiitiko che precipitate · Kuongorora kwekutanga nenheyo huru
chemistry-m2-l1.concept: Element chikamu chakakosha chinoumba zvinhu. Kana atomu ikarasikirwa neelectron inova positive ion, kana ikawana inova negative ion. Kana ion dzakati dzikasangana dzinoumba precipitate isingananyungudiki mumvura.
chemistry-m2-l1.example: Kana silver nitrate solution yawedzerwa musodium chloride solution, silver chloride ($\text{AgCl}$) precipitate chena inoumbwa.

chemistry-m2-l2.title: Element, atomu, ion nechiitiko che precipitate · Kuongorora data nekugadzirisa matambudziko
chemistry-m2-l2.concept: Kuvaka kugona kutsanangura data yekuyedza nekugadzirisa matambudziko ekushandisa muupenyu hwezuva nezuva pa element, atomu, ion nechiitiko che precipitate.
chemistry-m2-l2.example: Gadzira mhedziso dzesainzi dzekuongorora nekuongorora kukanganisa kuburikidza nekuongorora data yehuwandu.

chemistry-m3-l1.title: Kuchengetedzwa kwemass, mutemo wehuwandu hwakagara, kuburitsa nekutora kupisa · Kuongorora kwekutanga nenheyo huru
chemistry-m3-l1.concept: Pamberi nepashure pechiitiko chekemikari, rudzi nenhamba yeatomu hazvichinji, saka mass yose inochengetedzwa. Mucompound, huwandu hwemass pakati peelement dzinoiumba hunogara hwakafanana.
chemistry-m3-l1.example: Hydrogen $1\text{ g}$ neoxygen $8\text{ g}$ zvinosangana zvichiumba mvura $9\text{ g}$ (huwandu hwemass $1:8$).

chemistry-m3-l2.title: Kuchengetedzwa kwemass, mutemo wehuwandu hwakagara, kuburitsa nekutora kupisa · Kuongorora data nekugadzirisa matambudziko
chemistry-m3-l2.concept: Kuvaka kugona kutsanangura data yekuyedza nekugadzirisa matambudziko ekushandisa muupenyu hwezuva nezuva pakuchengetedzwa kwemass, mutemo wehuwandu hwakagara, kuburitsa nekutora kupisa.
chemistry-m3-l2.example: Gadzira mhedziso dzesainzi dzekuongorora nekuongorora kukanganisa kuburikidza nekuongorora data yehuwandu.

chemistry-h1-l1.title: Ionic bond, covalent bond nekuchinja kweelectron (oxidation-reduction) · Kuongorora kwekutanga nenheyo huru
chemistry-h1-l1.concept: Element dzinoumba ionic bond kana covalent bond kuti dzigutse octet rule (kurongeka kweelectron kweboka 18). Oxidation kurasikirwa neelectron, reduction kuwana electron.
chemistry-h1-l1.example: Sodium chloride ($\text{NaCl}$) hairatidzi kutakura magetsi kana iri chakasimba, asi kana yanyungudika mumvura ion dzinofamba uye magetsi anoyerera.

chemistry-h1-l2.title: Ionic bond, covalent bond nekuchinja kweelectron (oxidation-reduction) · Kuongorora data nekugadzirisa matambudziko
chemistry-h1-l2.concept: Kuvaka kugona kutsanangura data yekuyedza nekugadzirisa matambudziko ekushandisa muupenyu hwezuva nezuva paionic bond, covalent bond nekuchinja kweelectron (oxidation-reduction).
chemistry-h1-l2.example: Gadzira mhedziso dzesainzi dzekuongorora nekuongorora kukanganisa kuburikidza nekuongorora data yehuwandu.

chemistry-h2-l1.title: Mole (mol) nehukama hwehuwandu hwemachemical equations · Kuongorora kwekutanga nenheyo huru
chemistry-h2-l1.concept: Zvidimbu $6.02 \times 10^{23}$ zvinonzi $1\text{ mol}$. Huwandu hwemacoefficient emachemical equation hwakaenzana nehuwandu hwemole, huwandu hwemamorekuru, nehuwandu hwevolume yegasi.
chemistry-h2-l1.example: Volume ye $1\text{ mol}$ yegasi pa $0^\circ\text{C}$ ne $1\text{ atm}$ ndi $22.4\text{ L}$.

chemistry-h2-l2.example: Gadzira mhedziso dzesainzi dzekuongorora nekuongorora kukanganisa kuburikidza nekuongorora data yehuwandu.

chemistry-h3-l1.title: Kumhanya kwechiitiko, nheyo yaLe Chatelier nebhatiri rekemikari · Kuongorora kwekutanga nenheyo huru
chemistry-h3-l1.concept: Catalyst inochinja activation energy ichidzora kumhanya. Kana pakaiswa shanduko mu dynamic equilibrium system, equilibrium inofamba ichienda kunochengetedza shanduko iyoyo (nheyo yaLe Chatelier).
chemistry-h3-l1.example: Pakugadzira ammonia neHaber-Bosch process, kana kudzvinyirirwa kwakwidziwa, equilibrium inofamba ichienda kuchiitiko chekumberi apo nhamba yemamorekuru egasi inoderera.

chemistry-h3-l2.concept: Kuvaka kugona kutsanangura data yekuyedza nekugadzirisa matambudziko ekushandisa muupenyu hwezuva nezuva pakumhanya kwechiitiko, nheyo yaLe Chatelier nebhatiri rekemikari.

chemistry-e1-q1.prompt: Ndezvipi pazvinotevera zvakaroverwa nemazvo ‘chinhu’ (mudziyo) une chimiro chakananga uye kushandiswa kwakananga, ne‘zvinhu’ (zvekuvaka) zvakagadzirwa nazvo?

options.a: chair (mudziyo) — huni (zvinhu)

hints: ‘Chinhu’ ndiro zita remudziyo wakapedzwa watinoshandisa, uye ‘zvinhu’ ndiro zita rezvekuvaka.
Chair mudziyo, huni zvekuvaka.
chemistry-e1-q1.explanation: Mudziyo une chimiro nekushandiswa unonzi ‘chinhu’, uye zvekuvaka zvikuru zvakagadzirwa nazvo zvinonzi ‘zvinhu’.

chemistry-e1-q2.prompt: Ndeipi hunhu hwakananga hwezvinhu hwakaita sehwerabha kana bharuni, hunotambanuka kana ukadhonza nesimba uye hunodzoka kuchimiro chekutanga kana wasunungura?

options.a: kudzoka-kuchimiro

hints: Ihunhu hwekudzoka kuchimiro chekutanga.
Funga nezvekudzoka kuchimiro kunonzwika kurabha.
chemistry-e1-q2.explanation: Hunhu hwechinhu chakashanduka nesimba rekunze hwekudzoka kuchimiro chekutanga kana simba radzima hunonzi ‘kudzoka-kuchimiro’.

chemistry-e1-q3.prompt: Ndezvipi zvakaroverwa nemazvo pahunhu hwezvinhu zvinogadzira ‘jasi remvura’ rinopfekwa kana kunaya mvura ne‘magirazi ekushambira’ anoshandiswa kutamba mumvura?

options.a: Jasi remvura: kudzivirira mvura (hakubvumire mvura kupinda) / magirazi ekushambira: kujekesa (zvinoonekwa zvakajeka)
options.b: Jasi remvura: kutakura magetsi zvakanaka / magirazi ekushambira: kuputsika nyore
options.c: Jasi remvura: kupisika nyore / magirazi ekushambira: kuremera
options.d: Jasi remvura: kunyudza mvura zvakanaka / magirazi ekushambira: kusajeka

hints: Jasi remvura haribvumiri mvura kupinda, uye magirazi ekushambira anofanira kuita kuti uone pamberi zvakajeka.
Kushandiswa kwezvinhu kunosarudzwa nehunhu hwazvo.
chemistry-e1-q3.explanation: Jasi remvura rinogadzirwa nezvinhu zvinodzivirira mvura (vinyl/plastiki) kuti risanyura mvura, uye magirazi ekushambira anogadzirwa nepurasitiki kana girazi rakajeka kuti uone zvakanaka mumvura.

chemistry-e1-q4.prompt: Ndechipi chikonzero chesainzi chekuti muviri wepani kana poto yekubikira inoshandiswa kukicheni inogadzirwa nesimbi, uye ruoko rwayo rwuchigadzirwa nepurasitiki kana huni?

options.a: Nekuti simbi inotakura kupisa nokukurumidza, uye purasitiki nehuni hazvitakuri kupisa zvakanaka saka ruoko haruvakidzwe
options.c: Nekuti purasitiki inoshandura kuravira kwechikafu kuita kwakanaka

hints: Kuti chikafu chibikwe, kupisa kunofanira kutamira pazasi pepoto nokukurumidza.
Kana ruoko rwakapisa, hauchagoni kurubata.
chemistry-e1-q4.explanation: Simbi ine kutakura kupisa kwakawanda saka inobika chikafu nokukurumidza, uye purasitiki nehuni zvinodzivirira kupisa zvakanaka saka hausi kuvakidzwa kana ukabata ruoko panguva yekubika.

chemistry-e1-c.prompt: [Kunzvera nharaunda yepamusoro] Purasitiki yakareruka, yakasimba, uye haivori, asi kana yakarasirwa haigoni kuparara muchisikwa kwemazana emakore, ichisvibisa nharaunda. Ndeupi nzira yakarurama yekukudziridzwa kwesainzi yezvinhu yekugadzirisa izvi?

options.a: Kugadzira ‘purasitiki inovorera’ inogadzirwa nestarch yechibage uye zvimwe, inoparara zvinoitwa nezvipukanana
options.b: Kurasira purasitiki yose mugungwa kuti inyure
options.c: Kuviga purasitiki mukudzika kwevhu uye kuikanganwa
options.d: Kushandura zvinhu zvose zvekushandisa kuti zvive zvekushandisa kamwe chete

hints: Chinhu chitsva chinodiwa nenharaunda chinogona kudyiwa nokuparadzwa nezvipukanana.
Inzira yekuvorera (Biodegradable).
chemistry-e1-c.explanation: Kuderedza kusvibiswa kwenharaunda, purasitiki ine bio inovorera inogadzirwa nezvinhu zvemiti inokudziridzwa nesimba, inoparadzwa nezvipukanana kuita mvura nekabhoni dhaiokisaidhi mushure menguva.

chemistry-e1-q5.prompt: Zvipikiri kana shamba dzakagadzirwa nesimbi dzinoita ngura tsvuku kana dzaiswa mumvura nemuhwayo kwenguva refu. Ndeipi nzira yakarurama yesainzi yezvinhu yekudzivirira izvi?

options.a: Kuzora mafuta matete kana kupenda kuti kudzivirire mhepo nemvura kuti zvisabatane nazvo
options.c: Kushamba simbi nemvura ine munyu zuva rega rega
options.d: Kuomesa zvakanyanya muzuva uye kuzvichengeta zvichipisa zvakanyanya

hints: Kuti simbi ive ne ngura (oxidation), mweya (oxygen) nemvura zvose zvinodiwa.
Kuvhara pamusoro kunodzivirira mweya nemvura.
chemistry-e1-q5.explanation: Kuita ngura kwesimbi kunoitika nekubatana kwemweya (oxygen) nemvura, saka kuzora mafuta, kupenda, kana kuvhara nesimbi pamusoro kunodzivirira zvakakwana kubatana kwemhepo nemvura kuti ngura isaitike.

chemistry-e2-q1.prompt: Chii chinoitika kana ukaisa chipunu chimwe cheshuga mubheka rine mvura inodziya woisanganisa nedanda regirazi? Sarudza tsananguro yakarurama.

options.a: Zvidimbu zveshuga zvinopwanyika zviri zvidiki zvikapararira mumvura yose zvichisaonekwa
options.c: Shuga inokwira pamusoro pemvura ikabhururuka yose mumhepo
options.d: Mvura iri mubheka inoshanduka kuita nhema

hints: Tarisa kuwonekera kwekusungunuka (kunyungudika).
Inosvika pakujeka, asi kana wakaravira, ichiri inotapira.
chemistry-e2-q1.explanation: Kana shuga yanyungudika mumvura, mamorekuru eshuga anopararira zvakaenzana pakati pemamorekuru emvura, ichiita mvura yeshuga yakajeka isingaonekwi.

chemistry-e2-q2.prompt: Ndechipi chikonzero chekuti shuga inonyungudika nokukurumidza mumukombe wemvura inodziya kupfuura wemvura inotonhora?

options.a: Nekuti kana tembiricha yakwira, mamorekuru emvura anofamba zvakanyanya uye anobvisa zvidimbu zveshuga nokukurumidza
options.c: Nekuti mvura inodziya ine mhepo yakawanda mukati

hints: Kana tembiricha yakwira, mamorekuru anofamba nokukurumidza.
Fungidzira kana uchiisa shuga yemakuva mumukombe wetii ukasanganisa.
chemistry-e2-q2.explanation: Kana tembiricha yemvura yakwira, kufamba kwekupisa kwemamorekuru emvura kunowedzera uye anorova zvidimbu zveshuga kazhinji nesimba, saka kunyungudika kunokurumidza.

chemistry-e2-q3.prompt: Kana munyu-mvura nemvura ine matope zvikadururirwa chimwe nechimwe mufunnel ine mapepa ekusefa, chii chinosara pamapepa ekusefa? Sarudza kuroverwa kwakarurama.

options.a: Munyu-mvura: hapana chinosara / mvura ine matope: zvidimbu zvevhu zvinoramba pamapepa ekusefa
options.b: Munyu-mvura: pasara mapundu emunyu / mvura ine matope: hapana chinosara
options.c: Munyu-mvura nemvura ine matope zvose zvinopfuura papepa rekusefa sezvazvakaita
options.d: Munyu-mvura nemvura ine matope zvose zvinosara pamusoro pepepa rekusefa

hints: Zvidimbu zvesolution yakanyungudika zvachose zvidiki zvikuru kuringana maburi epepa rekusefa.
Zvidimbu zvevhu zvisina kunyungudika zvinoramba papepa rekusefa.
chemistry-e2-q3.explanation: Munyu unonyungudika zvachose, saka zvidimbu zvawo zviri zvidiki kupfuura macrack epepa rekusefa uye zvose zvinopfuura, asi zvidimbu zvevhu hazvinyungudiki saka hazvipfuuri mumaburi epepa rekusefa zvinosara.

chemistry-e2-q4.prompt: Ndeipi nzira yekushanduka kwemamiriro ezvinhu nekupatsanura inoshandiswa pamapani emunyu kuwana munyu wakachena watinodya kubva mumvura yegungwa?

options.a: Kuvhuvhutisa mvura nezuva nemhepo kuti mvura yegungwa ibude, zvichisiya makristasi emunyu chete
options.b: Kubira mvura yegungwa zvakakwana kuti ive chechine
options.c: Kuisa magineti mumvura yegungwa kuti ikwevere munyu
options.d: Kusefa nesefa kuti ubvise munyu chete mumvura yegungwa

hints: Mvura yegungwa yakaparadzirwa mudiki mumapani emunyu ichirohwa nezuva, mvura chete inoshanduka kuita mhute ikabhururuka.
Kupatsanura musanganiswa uchishandisa kuvhuvhuta.
chemistry-e2-q4.explanation: Kana mvura yegungwa yakaiswa mumapani emunyu uye mvura ikavhuvhutwa nezuva nemhepo, mvura chete inoshanduka kuita mhute yegasi ikabhururuka, uye makristasi emunyu akanyungudika chete anosara achichena.

chemistry-e2-c.prompt: [Kunzvera nheyo yepamusoro] Pane munyu-mvura wakagadzirwa nekunyungudisa zvachose 10 g yemunyu mu 100 g yemvura. Kana ukayera uremu hwemunyu-mvura wose nechiyero chemagetsi, ichava mangani g?
hints: Kunyange munyu wakanyungudika kusvika usisaonekwa, haana kutsakatika.
Kuchengetedzwa kwehuwandu: (uremu hwemvura) + (uremu hwemunyu) = ?
chemistry-e2-c.explanation: Kana chinhu chanyungudika, zvidimbu zvemunyu (solute) zvinongopararira pakati pemamorekuru emvura, hazvitsakatiki, saka uremu hwesolution yose hunochengetedzwa chaizvo pa 110 g, muhwomwe hwemvura nemunyu.

chemistry-e2-q5.prompt: Ndechipi chikonzero chekuti kunyangwe ukaisa mvura nemafuta ekubikisa mubhodhoro rimwe ukazunza zvakanyanya, kana wasiya zvakadzikama kwechinguva zvinodzokera kupatsanurwa mumatanho maviri?

options.a: Nekuti mafuta ekubikisa ane hunhu hwekusanganisa nemvura asi ane density diki kupfuura mvura, saka anoyangarara pamusoro
options.c: Nekuti mvura inodziya kupfuura mafuta ekubikisa
options.d: Nekuti mafuta ekubikisa akaomarara kuita chakasimba

hints: Mvura ine polarity uye mafuta haana polarity, saka haanyungudike pamwe.
Mafuta akareruka kupfuura mvura (density diki) saka anoyangarara pamusoro.
chemistry-e2-q5.explanation: Mvura imorekuru ine polarity uye mafuta ekubikisa mamorekuru asina polarity, saka haasanganisi, uye density yemafuta ekubikisa (angangoita 0.92 g/cm³) idiki kupfuura yemvura (1.0 g/cm³), saka anoyangarara kudanho repamusoro.

chemistry-e3-q1.prompt: Ndeupi mamiriro ezvinhu anochinja chimiro zvakasununguka zvichienderana nechirongo chinochiisa, asi huwandu hwawo (volume) hahuchinje uye hunogara hwakafanana?

options.a: mvura

hints: Fungidzira kana uchidurura mvura kana mukaka mumukombe mumwe.
Chimiro chinotevera mukombe, asi huwandu (volume) hwakaita sezvakaita.
chemistry-e3-q1.explanation: Mvura ine kubatana pakati pemamorekuru kunochinjika kupfuura chakasimba saka chimiro chinochinja nyore zvichienderana nechirongo, asi nekuti simba rekukwevera pakati pemamorekuru rinochengetedzwa, huwandu hunogara hwakafanana.

chemistry-e3-q2.prompt: Pashandiswa masyringe maviri, rimwe rakazadzwa nemvura rimwe nemhepo; mukanwa wepiston wakavharwa nechigunwe uye piston yakasundwa zvakasimba. Chii chinoitika?

options.a: Syringe ine mhepo piston inosundwa mukati zvakanaka, asi syringe ine mvura haisundwi zvakadaro
options.b: Syringe ine mvura inosundwa mukati zvakawanda kupfuura iya ine mhepo
options.c: Masyringe ose maviri anosundwa zvachose kusvika pakupera

hints: Mamorekuru egasi akaparadzaniswa zvakanyanya, saka kune nzvimbo isina chinhu yakawanda.
Gasi rinogona kudzvinyirirwa nyore, asi mvura inonetsa kwazvo kudzvinyirira.
chemistry-e3-q2.explanation: Gasi (mhepo) rine mamorekuru akaparadzaniswa zvakanyanya, saka kana pakaiswa kudzvinyirira rinodzvinyirirwa nyore uye huwandu hunoderera, asi mvura ine mamorekuru akatobatana saka haidzvinyirirwi zvakanyanya.

chemistry-e3-q3.prompt: Chii chinhu chakajairika chinowanzoonekwa pazvinhu zvakasimba zvinowanikwa munharaunda yedu?

options.a: Chimiro nehuwandu zvinogara zvakafanana kunyangwe chirongo chachinja
options.d: Zvinozadza nzvimbo yose uye zvinopararira zvisingaperi

hints: Fungidzira kana uchitamisa chimedu chehuni kana ibwe mubhokisi rimwe.
Chimiro hachichinji.
chemistry-e3-q3.explanation: Chakasimba chine zvidimbu zvinoumba chinhu zvakasungwa zvakasimba nenzira yakarongeka, saka chimiro nehuwandu zvinogara zvakafanana kunze kwekunge pakaiswa simba rekunze.

chemistry-e3-q4.prompt: Wakavhura chivharo chebhodhoro rekunhuhwirira mukona yeimba, uye mushure menguva pfupi munhu ari kune rimwe divi reimba akanzwa kunhuhwirira kuri nani. Ndeipi nheyo yesainzi inotsanangura izvi?

options.a: Chiitiko che‘kupararira’ apo zvidimbu zvegasi rekunhuhwirira zvinofamba pachazvo zvikapararira mumhepo
options.b: Nekuti mvura yekunhuhwirira yakaomarara ikamonya pasi
options.c: Nekuti mamorekuru ekunhuhwirira akakwevera mhino semagineti

hints: Zvidimbu zvinoumba chinhu hazvimire, zvinofamba pachazvo nguva dzose.
Chiitiko chekupararira kwegasi chinonzi chii?
chemistry-e3-q4.explanation: Chiitiko chekuti zvidimbu zvekunhuhwirira zvinofamba pachazvo nguva dzose mumhepo mune mativi ose, zvichibva panzvimbo ine huwandu hwakawanda zvichienda pane huwandu hushoma, chinonzi ‘kupararira’.

chemistry-e3-c.prompt: [Kufungidzira kwepamusoro] Mhepo isingaonekwi inewo here uremu (mass) senge chakasimba kana mvura? Ndeipi nzira yekuyedza yakanyanya kuringana yekuratidza izvi?

options.a: Kuyera bhora rebasketball rakazadzwa nemhepo nechiyero chemagetsi chakarurama, wozobvisa mhepo woyerazve kuti uone musiyano weuremu
options.c: Kuisa bhodhoro regirazi risina chinhu muzuva kuti uone kana richidziya
options.d: Kuisa ruoko mumvura kuyera kutonhora kwayo

hints: Gasi chinhu, saka rine mass.
Fananidza chiyero chechiyero kana mhepo yaiswa nekubvisiwa.
chemistry-e3-c.explanation: Kana wayera bhora rakazara nemhepo wozobvisa mhepo woyera zvakare, uremu hunodzikira, izvo zvinoratidza kuti mhepo, iri gasi, ine mass nouremu.

chemistry-e3-q5.prompt: Kana ‘dry ice’ inotonhora inoiswa mukurongedza ayisikirimu ikasiyiwa patembiricha yemuimba, hakuna matinji emvura anoumbwa uye inobhururuka zvakananga seshanduko yegasi. Shanduko iyi yemamiriro ezvinhu ndeipi?

options.a: ‘Sublimation’, apo chakasimba chinoshanduka kuita gasi pasina kupfuura nechemvura
options.d: ‘Kuvhuvhuta kuita mvura’, apo gasi rinoshanduka kuita mvura

hints: Dry ice kabhoni dhaiokisaidhi yakasimba.
Pa1 atmosphere nepatembiricha yemuimba, inosublimate zvakananga kuita gasi isingapfuuri nemamiriro emvura.
chemistry-e3-q5.explanation: Dry ice (kabhoni dhaiokisaidhi yakasimba) haigone kuvapo semvura pa1 atmosphere, uye inoratidza chiitiko che‘sublimation’ chekuchinja zvakananga kubva pachakasimba kuita gasi.

chemistry-e4-q1.prompt: Rakaiswa kanini pakati pemadiki emusoro muna tafura, kani yemvura inonwiwa yakabva mufiriji yakava nematinji emvura pamusoro payo. Matinji aya akabva kupi?

options.a: Mhute yegasi iri mumhepo yakabata kani inotonhora ikaita mvura (condensation)
options.b: Chinwiwa chakabuda kuburikidza nomadziro easiyamu ekani
options.c: Matinji akaumbwa nepende yakanyungudika pamusoro pekani

hints: Mhute isingaonekwi iri mumhepo nguva dzose.
Kana mhute ikasangana nepamusoro patonhora, inotonhodzwa ikaita matinji emvura (condensation).
chemistry-e4-q1.explanation: Ichi chiitiko che‘condensation (kuita mvura)’, apo mhute iri gasi iri mumhepo yakasangana nepamusoro pekani panotonhora ikarasikirwa nekupisa ikashanduka kuita matinji emvura.

chemistry-e4-q2.prompt: Kana mvura inoshanduka kuita chechine chakasimba, ndeupi mutsanangurire akarurama wekuchinja kweuremu nehuwandu?

options.a: Uremu hunogara hwakafanana, asi huwandu hunowedzera

hints: Kunyangwe mvura ikaita echine, nhamba yose yemamorekuru haichinji.
Kana mvura ikaita echine, inoita chimiro chemarongedzo matanhatu uye nzvimbo isina chinhu inowedzera.
chemistry-e4-q2.explanation: Kana mvura ikaita echine, mass (uremu) inochengetedzwa, asi nekuti mamorekuru emvura anoumba makristasi ane marongedzo matanhatu ane nzvimbo isina chinhu yakawanda nekubatana kwehydrogen, huwandu hunowedzera nekuda kwe10%.

chemistry-e4-q3.prompt: Ndechipi chikonzero chakakosha chesainzi chinoita kuti mapaipi emvura ekunze aputsike muchando chinotonhora?

options.a: Nekuti mvura iri mupaipi inowedzera huwandu kana yaita echine, ichisundira madziro epaipi zvakasimba
options.b: Nekuti paipi yesimbi inodzikira nechando ikanyungudika
options.c: Nekuti kudzvinyirirwa kwemvura kunowedzera kakumi muchando
options.d: Nekuti echine rinogadzira magetsi rinopisa paipi

hints: Fungidzira kuti huwandu hunochinja sei kana mvura ikashanduka kuita echine.
Kana mvura ikaita echine, huwandu hunowedzera.
chemistry-e4-q3.explanation: Mvura ine hunhu hwakasiyana hwekuwedzera huwandu kana ikaita echine, saka mvura iri mukati mepaipi izere kana ikaita echine, kudzvinyirirwa kwekuwedzera kunoputsa paipi yesimbi yakasimba.

chemistry-e4-q4.prompt: Ndeupi musiyano uri pakati pe‘kuvhuvhuta’ ne‘kuvira’ kunoitika kana mvura ichidziiswa mupoto?

options.a: Kuvhuvhuta kunoitika pamusoro pemvura chete, uye kuvira kunoitika pakuvira (100℃) apo mabhubhu anoumbwa pamusoro napakati pemvura yose
options.b: Kuvhuvhuta kunoitika pa100℃ chete, uye kuvira kunoitika patembiricha dzose
options.c: Kuvhuvhuta ndiko mvura kuita echine, uye kuvira ndiko kuita mhute

hints: Kuomarara kwenguvo kunoitika kuvhuvhuta kunononoka pamusoro patembiricha yakaderera.
Kuvira zvakanyanya kwemvura ndiko kuvira apo mabhubhu anopasuka mukati patembiricha ye100 degrees.
chemistry-e4-q4.explanation: Kuvhuvhuta ndiko mvura inoshanduka kuita gasi patembiricha iri pasi pekuvira pamusoro pemvura, uye kuvira ndiko kuvhuvhuta kunoitika zvakanyanya nepamusoro napakati pemvura yose kana yasvika pakuvira.

chemistry-e4-c.prompt: [Shanduko yemamiriro ezvinhu yepamusoro] Mvura iri mubheka yakadziiswa ikatanga kuvira zvakanyanya. Kunyangwe ukawedzera simba remoto ukaramba uchipisa, ndechipi chikonzero chekuti mutsara wethermometer usingakwire pamusoro pe100℃?

options.a: Nekuti simba rekupisa rinopiwa rinoshandiswa rose pakushandura mvura kuita mhute (kupisa kwekuvira), kwete kukwidza tembiricha yemvura
options.b: Nekuti thermometer inoparara kana ichipfuura 100 degrees

hints: Panguva yekuchinja kwemamiriro, tembiricha yechinhu inogara yakafanana.
Izvi zvinonzi ‘kupisa kwakavanzika (latent heat, kupisa kwekuvira)’.
chemistry-e4-c.explanation: Panguva iyo mvura yakachena ichivira, simba rekupisa rinoshandiswa rose pakutyora simba rekukwevera pakati pemamorekuru nekuashandura kuita gasi (kupisa kwekuvira), saka tembiricha inogara yakafanana kusvika mvura yose yashanduka kuita mhute.

chemistry-e4-q5.prompt: Chii chinoratidzwa nenzira kwayo yemamiriro ezvinhu e‘dew’ yakajeka inoumbwa pamashizha mangwanani, uye ‘frost’ chena inoumbwa pawindo nepadenga usiku hwekupera kwerudo? Sarudza kuroverwa kwakarurama.

options.a: Dew: mhute inoshanduka kuita matinji emvura (condensation) / frost: mhute inoshanduka zvakananga kuita makristasi echine (sublimation yekudzoka)
options.b: Dew: echine rinonyungudika (melting) / frost: mvura inovira (vaporization)
options.c: Dew nefrost zvose mvura yakavhuvhuta ikaita mhute
options.d: Dew: mvura yechitubu inobuda pasi / frost: chando chinobva kudenga

hints: Dew matinji emvura (mhute → mvura).
Frost makristasi echine anoumbwa patembiricha iri pasi pezero (mhute → chakasimba).
chemistry-e4-q5.explanation: Dew mhute iri mumhepo inoshanduka kuita mvura (condensation) pamusoro pemashizha anotonhora usiku, uye frost mhute inoshanduka zvakananga kuita makristasi echine pasina kupfuura nemvura patembiricha iri pasi pezero.

chemistry-e5-q1.prompt: 50 g yeshuga yakaiswa mu 200 g yemvura ikanyungudika zvachose. Mune iyi mvura yeshuga, ‘solvent’, ‘solute’ ne‘solution’ zvakaroverwa sei zvakanaka?

options.a: Solvent: mvura / solute: shuga / solution: mvura yeshuga
options.b: Solvent: shuga / solute: mvura / solution: mvura yeshuga
options.c: Solvent: mvura yeshuga / solute: shuga / solution: mvura
options.d: Solvent: mvura / solute: mvura yeshuga / solution: shuga

hints: Mvura inonyungudisa = solvent, chinhu chinonyungudika = solute, musanganiswa wakapedzwa = solution.
Muna mvura yeshuga, shuga inonyungudika ndiyo solute, mvura inonyungudisa ndiyo solvent.
chemistry-e5-q1.explanation: Mvura inonyungudisa inonzi ‘solvent’, shuga inonyungudika inonzi ‘solute’, uye musanganiswa wakajeka wakasanganiswa zvakaenzana unonzi ‘solution’.

chemistry-e5-q2.prompt: Tiri kunzvera hunhu hwesolution yemunyu-mvura iri mubheka. Ndeupi tsananguro yakarurama yehunhu hwesolution, ayo ari musanganiswa une homogeneous?

options.a: Kunyangwe ukatora pamusoro, pakati kana pazasi pesolution ukaravira, kuvava (concentration) kwakafanana zvachose
options.b: Nekufamba kwenguva, munyu unorema ukanyura pasi pachawo
options.c: Kana ukatarisa nelens, unoona zvidimbu zvemunyu zvichiyangarara mumvura
options.d: Kana ukasefa nepepa rekusefa, munyu wose unosara papepa

hints: Solution musanganiswa ‘une homogeneous’ une zvidimbu zvakasanganiswa zvakaenzana pamoreku.
Hazvinyure kunyangwe ukasiya kwenguva refu.
chemistry-e5-q2.explanation: Solution yechokwadi (musanganiswa une homogeneous) ine zvidimbu zvesolute zvakapararira zvakaenzana pakati pemamorekuru esolvent, saka hazvinyure kunyangwe zvikasiiwa kwenguva refu uye concentration yakafanana pose.

chemistry-e5-q3.prompt: Kana munyu waiswa mu 100 g yemvura, ndechipi chikonzero chekuti munyu unonyungudika zvakawanda pa60℃ kupfuura pa20℃?

options.a: Nekuti kana tembiricha yakwira, kufamba kwekupisa kwemamorekuru esolvent kunowedzera uye solubility (kugona kuchengeta solute) kunowedzera
options.b: Nekuti tembiricha yakakwira inoparadza chimiro chemamorekuru emunyu

hints: Fungidzira curve yekuchinja kwesolubility netembiricha.
Kana yakawanda kudziya, kufamba kwemamorekuru echinhu kunowedzera.
chemistry-e5-q3.explanation: Mazhinji emasolutes akasimba, kana tembiricha ikakwira, kufamba kwezvidimbu zvesolvent kunowedzera, uye nekuda kwemamiriro e enthalpy yekunyungudika, solubility (huwandu hwakawanda hunogona kunyungudika mune huwandu hwakapihwa hwesolvent) inowedzera.

chemistry-e5-q4.prompt: Tomato diki yakaiswa mubheka remvura isina chinhu yakanyura pasi. Mushure mekuisa munyu wakawanda nekuuya, tomato diki yakaoneka ichiyangarara pamusoro. Chikonzero ndechipi?

options.a: Nekuti munyu wakanyungudika wakaita kuti density yesolution yemunyu-mvura ipfuure density yetomato diki
options.b: Nekuti munyu wakadya tomato diki zvishoma nezvishoma
options.c: Nekuti tomato diki yakatonhora ikabudisa mhepo

hints: Kana density yemvura ichipfuura yechinhu, chinhu chinoyangarara.
Kana munyu wakawanda wanyungudika, uremu (density) hwemvura hunowedzera.
chemistry-e5-q4.explanation: Munyu-mvura ine density yakakura kupfuura mvura isina chinhu, uye kana munyu uchinyungudika zvakanyanya kusvika density yemunyu-mvura yapfuura density yepakati petomato diki, simba rekukwidza rinopfuura simba rekukwevera pasi uye tomato inoyangarara.

chemistry-e5-c.prompt: [Crystallization yepamusoro] Solution yakazara (saturated) yealum yakagadzirwa nekunyungudisa alum mumvura inodziya ye60℃ kusvika isingachanyungudiki, ndokuturikidza tambo yesirika mukati mayo, ndokurega itonhorera zvishoma nezvishoma. Makristasi emhando yembiru akapenya akakura patambo yesirika. Nheyo yeiyi shanduko ndeipi?

options.a: Kana tembiricha yaderera, solubility yealum inodzikira, saka huwandu hwakapfuura hunosara hwakasimba hunoumba makristasi
